proposed_widenings.name: DamageTypeRef.gm_determined_table
proposed_widenings.justification: The potion's damage type is determined by the GM (by choice or random d10 roll), not by the player/caster. CastTimeChoice is explicitly 'Caster picks one at cast/build time' which is a different semantic — player agency vs GM agency. There is no variant in DamageTypeRef for GM-selected or random-table-selected damage types.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. [d10 table of 10 damage types]

notes: The rest of the unit maps cleanly: MagicItemRecord with ActivatedAbilityMechanics (activationCost: action, resource: use_count fixed 1, resetCadence: never, destruction: permanent_on_empty), duration: timed 1 hour, effect: grant_resistance. The sole gap is that DamageTypeRef has no variant for GM-determined / random-table selection. Adding { kind: 'gm_determined_table'; options: ReadonlyNonEmptyArray<DamageType> } to DamageTypeRef would fully close the gap. No new v4 atom is needed; only a surface-level variant addition.
